item.tib: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs gsang ba sgo dgu'i sgrub pa las snang srid rab 'byams skong ba'i mdos 'phyong
item.coloph: ces gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs kyi nang nas/ a dkar theg pa chen po'i grol phug(phugs) gsas mkhar gsang ba sgo dgu'i sgrub pa las/ snang srid rab 'byams bskang(skong) ba'i mdos 'phyong 'di yang / 'chi med yum sras gshen gyi lung don/ gshen chen gsang ba 'dus pa'i thugs bcud/ dbal gshen stag la nyid kyis mdzad srol/ bla chen dran pa nam mkha'i brnags pa/ stang chen dmu tsha nyid kyi dmar (smar) byang 'di yang / mkhas pa rin chen blo gsal gyi gar rol/ spyang 'phags gdung grol/ mnyam med tshul khrims dbang drags (grags) mchog gis bka' gsungs (gsung) spyi bor phab pa dang / ma zad drang srong nam mkha' tshul khrims dang*/ rigs mthun bka' slob btsun pa tshul khrims blo gros dang / dad ldan sbyin bdag mi dbang bsod nams 'brug rgyal sogs kyis bskul pa la brten nas/ skabs su bab pa'i kho bo tha shal ba/ sprul sku blo ldan snying po'i rjes 'bring / stang chen bka' yi pho nya/ tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyi snying bu/ u0f38tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am 7gsang ba'i ming ni7g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa des/ stang chen dmu tsha'i zhal lung bzhin du dkar chag yi ger gtab pa'o/ dge ba ci mchis ma gyur 'gro la bsngo'o//
